topic: The Counterintuitive Money Lesson From Someone Who Died Completely Broke Despite Earning Fortunes

artifacts.angle: A cautionary tale of a golden-era entertainer who made millions but understood cash flow too late, revealing the danger of confusing gross revenue with net wealth.
artifacts.hook: He earned more than movie stars in his prime, but when he died, he couldn't afford his own funeral. This is where every dollar went.
